{{Quote|What if we get there and the shield is still up? We'll be hung out to dry.''"<br/ >"''You don't know Han and Luke too well, do you?|Randi and Wedge Antilles prior to the Battle of Endor|<ref name="BRG" />}}
'''Randi''' was a young rookie [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who joined [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. They fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as a pilot in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. Prior to the battle he attended a briefing held by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. It is unknown whether Randi survived the battle.
